title: Kragan Gorr
description: The scarred Quarren Kragan Gorr was a notorious and brutal pirate operating in the Outer Rim, particularly on the planet of Castilon. Under the cover of the environmental threats of the watery planet, Gorr and his crew would lead ruthless attacks against the Colossus. Worse than that, he was also secretly in league with the nefarious First Order.
